# Piney Digital

> Piney Digital builds custom websites, custom operational software, dashboards and integrations for Texas service businesses, especially multi-location businesses. Based in Lufkin, TX. Founded by Joel Escoto. Serves Lufkin, Nacogdoches, Tyler, Conroe, Cleveland and Houston, TX.

Key facts:
- Starter website: starts at $799. 3-5 pages, custom design, mobile-responsive, basic SEO, contact form. Delivered in 1-2 weeks.
- Concept Site: starts at $3,500. 5-20 pages, custom design (no templates), SEO optimized, contact forms, analytics setup. Delivered in 2-3 weeks.
- Custom software and platforms: quoted per project. Typically 6-10 weeks for core features, an admin dashboard and user accounts.
- Every project includes training, documentation and 90 days of support. After that: Self-Hosted, Managed Care, or a Partner Retainer.
- Clients own everything built for them: source code, documentation, domains, hosting accounts and business data.
- Free 15-minute audit to see whether custom software or a new website is the right move.
- Phone: (936) 240-9881

## Services
- [Services overview](https://pineydigital.com/services/): Websites, custom software, automation and dashboards for Texas service businesses.
- [Websites](https://pineydigital.com/services/websites/): Custom-designed, mobile-responsive business websites. Starter from $799, Concept Site from $3,500. Includes process, managed hosting and common questions.
- [Custom software](https://pineydigital.com/services/custom-software/): Operational software built around how your business runs, with dashboards, user roles, admin panels and integrations. Quoted per project.
- [Dashboards](https://pineydigital.com/services/dashboards/): Operational dashboards for multi-location businesses: compare stores, track costs and see week-over-week changes.
- [Automation and integrations](https://pineydigital.com/services/automation/): Connect POS, CRM and accounting tools so information moves on its own.

## Company
- [Pricing](https://pineydigital.com/pricing): Starter websites at $799, concept sites from $3,500, custom software quoted per project. No monthly fees required.
